author: Chris Schommer
title: Reid Detmers limits damage in win over Athletics
desc: Reid Detmers allowed two earned runs on four hits and three walks while striking out eight over 5 2/3 innings in Saturday's win over the Athletics.
impact: Detmers continues a steady stretch on the mound of late, allowing two earned runs or less in four of his last five trips to the mound. The left-hander offers manager Kurt Suzuki one of the more stable starting options in the Angels rotation, carrying a 3.88 ERA and 1.06 WHIP with a 3-5 record and 10.1 K/9 ratio across 17 starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Kirby Yates nails down save in win over Athletics
desc: Kirby Yates struck out one batter to earn the save in Saturday's 5-2 win over the Athletics.
impact: Yates continues a steady stretch out of the bullpen, holding opponents scoreless in seven of his last eight trips to the mound. The right-hander will look to provide manager Kurt Suzuki with more stability in the closer role out of the Angels bullpen, posting a 3.06 ERA and 0.96 WHIP with two saves across 21 appearances.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Josh Lowe steals base in win over Athletics
desc: Josh Lowe went 1-for-3 in a win over the Athletics with one run scored and one stolen base.
impact: Lowe has been impactful at the plate since being called back up, recording hits in each of his last three contests. The 28-year-old remains one of many underwhelming options in the Angels lineup for manager Kurt Suzuki, batting .200 with five home runs, 14 RBI, nine runs scored, and two stolen bases across 48 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jack Perkins solid on mound in loss to Angels
desc: Jack Perkins allowed two earned runs on four hits and one walk while striking out five over five innings in Saturday's loss to the Angels.
impact: Perkins has struggled to miss opposing bats of late, allowing three earned runs or more in four of his last five trips to the mound. The right-hander continues to frustrate fantasy managers with inconsistent command, posting a 6.00 ERA and 1.33 WHIP with a 2-3 record and 10.9 K/9 ratio through 22 appearances.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Colby Thomas chips in RBI, swipes base in loss
desc: Colby Thomas went 1-for-3 in a loss to the Angels with an RBI and one stolen base.
impact: Thomas continues an underwhelming stretch at the plate, picking up hits in one of his last 10 contests. The outfielder remains one of the more underwhelming bats when in the Athletics lineup for manager Mark Kotsay, slashing .211 with two home runs, seven RBI, eight runs scored, and one stolen base across 36 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jonah Heim homers in loss to Angels
desc: Jonah Heim went 1-for-3 with a solo home run and one walk in Saturday's loss to the Angels.
impact: Heim continues a productive stretch at the plate, driving in runs in five of his last seven contests. The 31-year-old remains one of many streaky bats in the Athletics lineup for manager Mark Kotsay, hitting .246 with seven home runs, 20 RBI, and 17 runs scored across 39 games.

author: Nate Miller
title: Bryce Harper smokes two-run homer in Saturday's loss
desc: Bryce Harper went 2-for-4 with a two-run homer in Saturday's 6-2 loss to the Mets.
impact: Harper provided the entirety of the Phillies' run production Saturday, launching his 19th home run of the season over the wall in left-center in the third inning. The two-time MVP has been absolutely destroying the baseball recently, delivering six multi-hit performances over the last eight games. In that span, Harper has gone 17-for-33 (.515 AVG) with four homers and 10 RBI.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Rafael Devers goes deep twice in win over Braves
desc: Rafael Devers went 2-for-3 in a 5-0 win over the Braves with two home runs, two runs scored, and four RBI.
impact: Devers continues a productive stretch at the plate, driving in runs in seven of his last 10 contests. The first baseman remains one of many streaky options in the Giants lineup for manager Tony Vitello, slashing .240 with 14 homers, 43 RBI, and 38 runs scored through 82 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Logan Webb cruises through seven scoreless in win over Braves
desc: Logan Webb allowed one hit and two walks while striking out six over seven innings in Saturday's win over the Braves.
impact: Webb continues a strong stretch on the mound since returning from injury, allowing two earned runs or less in each of his last six starts. The right-hander continues to return to the top-tier starting option fantasy managers expected, carrying a 3.09 ERA and 1.06 WHIP with a 5-5 record and 7.6 K/9 ratio across 14 starts.

author: Nate Miller
title: Bryce Elder struggles again in Saturday's loss to Giants
desc: Bryce Elder allowed five runs on five hits and one walk while striking out four over four innings in Saturday's 5-0 loss to the Giants.
impact: Over his first 14 starts of the season, Elder posted an excellent 2.66 ERA and 1.05 WHIP while allowing just seven homers across 84 2/3 innings. Things have turned completely south for the right-hander since. Elder has surrendered at least five earned runs in each of his last three starts, limping to a 12.21 ERA while giving up five long balls in just 14 innings. Elder's GB% has fallen from 45.0 to 32.7 between the two time frames, and his K% has dropped from 20.8 to 16.4. Holding onto Elder in standard fantasy formats is a difficult ask right now.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Kyle Harrison steady on mound in no-decision
desc: Kyle Harrison allowed two earned runs on three hits and one walk while striking out nine over five innings in Saturday's loss to the Cubs.
impact: Harrison continues an impressive stretch on the mound, allowing two earned runs or less in 14 of his 15 trips to the mound. The left-hander has formed an elite starting tandem with right-hander Jacob Misiorowski at the top of the Brewers rotation for fantasy managers, carrying a 2.57 ERA and 1.03 WHIP with an 8-1 record and 11.2 K/9 ratio across 15 starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jackson Chourio goes deep, swipes base in loss to Cubs
desc: Jackson Chourio went 1-for-4 in a loss to the Cubs with a solo home run and one stolen base.
impact: Chourio has caught fire again at the plate, collecting hits in seven of his last eight contests. The outfielder continues to reward manager Pat Murphy with one of the more dynamic options in the Brewers lineup, posting an .881 OPS with 11 home runs, six stolen bases, 31 RBI, and 33 runs scored across 46 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jimmy Herget locks down save in win over Twins
desc: Jimmy Herget tossed 2/3 of a scoreless inning to record the save in Saturday's win over the Twins.
impact: Herget continues a steady stretch out of the bullpen, holding opponents scoreless in five of his last six trips to the mound. The right-hander will look to remain a stable closing option as the season continues, posting a 4.05 ERA and 1.35 WHIP with a 0-2 record, four holds, and three saves across 20 appearances.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Michael Lorenzen survives traffic in win over Twins
desc: Michael Lorenzen allowed two earned runs on seven hits while striking out one over 5 2/3 innings in Saturday's win over the Twins.
impact: Lorenzen has struggled to miss opposing bats of late, allowing three earned runs or more in five of his last eight trips to the mound. The right-hander remains one of many dismal starting options in the Rockies rotation, posting a 6.83 ERA and 1.79 WHIP with a 3-9 record and 7.3 K/9 ratio across 18 starts.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Kyle Karros goes yard in win over Twins
desc: Kyle Karros went 1-for-3 in a win over the Twins with a two-run home run.
impact: Karros has heated back up at the plate, picking up hits in each of his last five contests. The23-year-old remains one of many inconsistent bats in the Rockies lineup, slashing .253 with five home runs, 23 RBI, 36 runs scored, and two stolen bases across 78 games.
